newsitem.title: UK: Bank of Cyprus sets 40 mln Cyprus pound bond.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus sets 40 mln Cyprus pound bond.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus Ltd has issued a convertible bond for up to 40 million Cyprus pounds, lead manager Salomon Brothers International said.
The deal has a seven-year maturity with a call after three years and is subject to a 130 percent hurdle thereafter.
It is due to be priced during the week of October 28. The indicated coupon range is 6.5 to 7.0 percent. The indicated conversion premium is 10 to 15 percent.
Issue price is par, and the par value is 1,000 Cyprus pounds.
The subordinated convertible bonds are listed in Luxembourg and are governmed by English law.
